powers.name: Blast Rune
powers.summary: As a standard action, create an invisible rune in an adjacent square that lasts for rounds equal to cleric level or until triggered. The creature entering the square takes 1d6 damage plus 1 per two cleric levels of a chosen energy type. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Spell Rune
powers.summary: Attach a qualifying targeted spell to one blast rune so the creature triggering it is also affected by that spell. The attached spell must be at least one level lower than the highest-level cleric spell you can cast.

powers.name: Storm Burst
powers.summary: As a standard action, make a ranged touch attack against a foe within 30 feet. Deal 1d6 nonlethal damage plus 1 per two cleric levels and impose a -2 penalty on attack rolls for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Lightning Lord
powers.summary: Call down a number of lightning bolts per day equal to cleric level. Any number may be used with one standard action, but each creature can be targeted only once and targets must be within 30 feet of each other; otherwise functions as call lightning.
